prompt_text: Who is the best moving company in Pleasanton CA for a local move?
answer_verbatim:
For a **local move in Pleasanton**, **Ontrack Moving** looks like a strong first company to get a quote from: it serves Pleasanton and reports a 4.9/5 rating across more than 2,800 reviews. That’s a useful signal, though it’s the company’s own review summary, not an independent guarantee. [Ontrack Moving](https://www.ontrackmoving.com/pleasanton-movers)

I’d compare it with **Magic Moving & Storage**, which is based in Pleasanton and has licensing information listed by moveBuddha. [Magic Moving & Storage](https://www.movebuddha.com/movers/ca/magic-moving-storage-2669/)

Before booking, get **at least three written estimates**, confirm the company’s California **CPUC “T” license** and insurance, and ask whether the quote is binding or hourly—including travel time, minimum hours, and any stair or packing fees.
